description: Schema v1 of the delivery stream.

attempt_pulls.description: S704 pull requests of the Work Item closed without merge (never integrated)

author_role.description: S704 author of the closed pull request: OWNER, APP, AGENT, OTHER

close_by.description: S704 who recorded the class: OWNER, PILOT, AGENT, OTHER

close_class.description: S704 the CloseRecord class: SUPERSEDED_FULL, SUPERSEDED_PARTIAL, REDIRECTED, SEQUENCED, CARRIED, PROBE (none: missing or invalid)

close_counts.description: S704 pull requests closed without merge per CloseRecord class (MISSING: none valid)

close_invalid.description: S704 why the CloseRecord is missing or invalid

close_source.description: S704 S693_CARRIER, S701_DECIDED, S702_WIP, DISPOSITION_RECORD, OWNER_LINE, CLOSE_COMMENT, TITLE_DECLARATION

close_valid.description: S704 the CloseRecord satisfies its class evidence rule

closed_ts.description: S704 when the pull request closed

closer_role.description: S704 who closed it: OWNER, APP, AGENT, OTHER

comment_id.description: S704 the maintained delivery-state comment on the Owner thread

comment_sha.description: S704 sha256 prefix of the comment body

comment_status.description: S704 POSTED, PATCHED, UNCONFIRMED, FAILED or REFUSED_HOST_DETAIL

comment_version.description: S704 its version (posts and edits that read back)

custody_word.description: S704 the goal custody state:reason of the Work Item

delivery_class.description: S704 the Work Item problem class: SOLVED, IN_PROGRESS, DEFERRED, UNSOLVED_UNSCHEDULED, UNSOLVED, CLOSED_UNVERIFIED, NOT_PLANNED

delivery_metrics.description: S704 unmerged closes, valid CloseRecords and their percent (target 100), orphaned follow-ups (target 0), close-to-successor latency p50/max, closes in the window

delivery_tag.description: S704 F (recorded fact), D (deterministic derivation) or J (human judgment)

derived.description: computed from other records; replaced on recomputation

digest_changed.description: S704 the digest changed (false: the hourly heartbeat)

entity.description: key of a mutable entity: keep the latest version (by ts, then record_id)

finding_entered.description: S704 the finding was entered (false: it left)

finding_id.description: S704 the finding id (stable per kind, subject and key)

finding_kind.description: S704 FALSE_SOLVED, UNEVIDENCED_CLOSE, STALE_RECORD, ATTEMPT_UNRECORDED, MISSING_CLOSE_RECORD, INVALID_CLOSE_RECORD, FALSE_SUPERSEDED, ORPHANED_FOLLOW_UP, SEQUENCED_BLOCKED, FORGOTTEN, RESUME_DUE, REVIEW_DUE, ATTEMPT_UNOWNED, FOLLOW_UP, TRIAGE

follow_up.description: S704 the follow-up status per successor: SCHEDULED, PENDING, OPENED, MERGED, ORPHANED

forgotten_tier.description: S704 ATTEMPT_DROPPED, CUSTODY_DONE_OPEN, INTEGRATED_OPEN or NEVER_ADMITTED

in_window.description: S704 closed inside the attempt window (attempt_window_days)

integrated_items.description: S704 Work Items with at least one merged pull request

integrated_pulls.description: S704 merged pull requests bound to the Work Item

integrated_total.description: S704 merged pull requests bound to Work Items

mention_status.description: S704 what the record line says of the pull request: PENDING or LANDED

open_pulls.description: S704 open pull requests bound to the Work Item

owner_queue_action.description: S708 DASHBOARD_CREATE, DASHBOARD_FOUND, DASHBOARD_EDIT, DASHBOARD_REOPEN, CONFIG_WRITE, PIN, LABEL_CREATE, LABEL_ADD, LABEL_REMOVE, ANSWER_RECORDED, REACTION, MENTION

owner_queue_age_s.description: S708 the item age when it entered or left (unit: s)

owner_queue_ages_s.description: S708 the age in seconds of every pending Owner decision, oldest first

owner_queue_changed.description: S708 the set digest changed (false: the hourly heartbeat)

owner_queue_chars.description: S708 the dashboard body size in characters

owner_queue_comment.description: S708 the answer comment (an item that left) or the comment written (an effect)

owner_queue_critical.description: S708 pending Owner decisions on the critical path (Owner-ordered work items, S702 WIP units)

owner_queue_effects.description: S708 provider effects enabled (false: the set is computed and recorded only)

owner_queue_entered.description: S708 the item entered the set (false: it left, answered or resolved)

owner_queue_item.description: S708 sha256 prefix of the pending item id (stable per decision)

owner_queue_items.description: S708 items named by one mention

owner_queue_kind.description: S708 the kind of the pending item

owner_queue_kinds.description: S708 pending Owner decisions per kind (DISPOSITION, TRIAGE, DELIVERY:<finding>, STARVATION, ...)

owner_queue_n.description: S708 pending Owner decisions in the set (every one listed, no cap)

owner_queue_oldest_s.description: S708 age of the oldest pending Owner decision (unit: s)

owner_queue_on_path.description: S708 the item is on the critical path

owner_queue_sha.description: S708 sha256 prefix of the dashboard body

owner_queue_source.description: S708 its producer source: disposition, triage, register, escalation, custody

owner_queue_sources.description: S708 producer sources per read status (OK, or the error class of an unreadable one)

owner_queue_status.description: S708 the effect outcome after its readback (CREATED, EDITED, CONFIRMED, UNCONFIRMED, REFUSED, PINNED, PIN_UNAVAILABLE, ...)

owner_queue_subjects.description: S708 the issue and pull request numbers the item names (the labelled subjects)

owner_queue_tier.description: S708 the mention tier in days (3, then 7)

record_id.description: stable id: sha256 of the source pointer and the normalized content, or of an explicit identity for observations, snapshots and derived rows

record_line.description: S704 the line of that record

record_ref.description: S704 the knowledge record a STALE_RECORD names (decision:NNNN, runbook:<name>, orientation:<ext>, roadmap)

register_digest.description: S704 the register digest (sha256 prefix, volatile fields excluded)

register_status.description: S704 CURRENT, STALE or INCOMPLETE (a mandatory source missing or stale)

resume_condition.description: S704 the first typed resume condition of a deferred Work Item

resume_conditions.description: S704 every typed resume condition (AFTER_MERGE, AFTER_DATE, OWNER_ADMISSION, WIP_SLOT, HOLD_RELEASE, OWNER_DECISION, CAPABILITY, EXCLUDED)

resume_satisfied.description: S704 every resume condition is satisfied

review_ts.description: S704 the deferral review date (explicit or the fallback)

roadmap_labels.description: S704 roadmap and lifecycle labels of the Work Item

route.description: S704 CUSTODY_ADMISSION, ROUTER_REQUEST, ATTEMPT_LINE, DISPOSITION_REVIEW, OWNER_ESCALATION, OWNER_TRIAGE

route_status.description: S704 the outcome of the routing effect (ADMITTED, DELIVERED, POSTED, PRESENT, QUEUED, RECORDED, BOUND, ...)

source_states.description: S704 sources per coverage state (COMPLETE, PARTIAL, STALE, MISSING)

successor_latency_s.description: S704 time from the close to the first successor pull request (unit: s)

successor_pulls.description: S704 the successor pull requests opened for the closed one

ts.description: UTC time of the fact; the partition day

ts_basis.description: set when ts is not the record time itself

typed_close.description: S704 the pilot's typed close that closed it (S693_CARRIER, S701_DECIDED, S702_WIP)

unbound_merged.description: S704 merged pull requests with no Work Item binding

units.description: unit of every field of the record that has one

work_item_state.description: S704 the provider state of the Work Item (open, closed)

title: delivery
